title: Adaptive Conformal Inference for Time Series
journal_or_venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)

content.abstract_summary: Presents Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI), a framework that updates non-conformity thresholds dynamically to maintain valid empirical coverage on sequential, non-exchangeable time series data with temporal autocorrelation and distribution shifts.
key_findings: Standard conformal prediction fails under temporal autocorrelation; ACI dynamically updates prediction bands to guarantee long-run coverage
Proves that online gradient-descent style threshold updates achieve exact asymptotic coverage even under arbitrary non-stationary processes
Demonstrates minimal tracking lag on volatile time-series trajectories
Essential foundation for applying distribution-free UQ to individual longitudinal PK/PD concentration-time curves
limitations: Finite-sample guarantees are asymptotic in time-series length T
Step-size parameter γ requires tuning to balance responsiveness against band stability

extracted_claims.text: Adaptive Conformal Inference achieves valid empirical coverage on arbitrary non-exchangeable time series by adjusting the confidence level dynamically online.

gaps_addressed: Enables conformal prediction bounds on longitudinal time-series PK concentration trajectories in Pillar 2 (M2.2)

provenance.notes: Added 2026-08-29 by Antigravity review. Core reference for time-series conformal inference in Pillar 2.
